select * from Group_Fund_Plan where Group_Fund_Plan.id in
#{item}

select gfp.*, gfp.id as gfpId, pp.P_Competent_Department as gfpsProjectCompetentDepartmentId, sd1.D_Name as gfpsProjectCompetentDepartmentName, pp.P_Department as gfpsProjectDepartmentId, sd2.D_Name as gfpsProjectDepartmentName, pp.P_Name as pname, pp.P_Name as projectName, mn.id as gfpsdId, mn.Remark_Context as remarkContext, mn.Gfp_Fund_Apply_Amount_Gc_Audit as gfpFundApplyAmountGcAudit, mn.Gfp_Fund_Apply_Amount_Cw_Audit as gfpFundApplyAmountCwAudit, gfp2.groupCount from Group_Fund_Plan_Summary_Detail mn left join Group_Fund_Plan_Summary gfps on mn.Gfps_Id = gfps.Id left join Group_Fund_Plan gfp on mn.Gfp_Id = gfp.Id left join Pre_Project pp on gfp.Project_ID = pp.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd1 on pp.P_Competent_Department = sd1.D_Id left join SYS_Department sd2 on pp.P_Department = sd2.D_Id left join ( select Group_Id, count(1) as groupCount from Group_Fund_Plan where del_flag = 0 group by Group_Id ) gfp2 on gfp.Group_Id = gfp2.Group_Id where mn.gfps_Id = #{id} and mn.del_flag = 0 and mn.status = 0 and gfp.del_flag = 0 order by gfp.Create_Time desc
